newsitem.title: ITALY: SAI to name two new heads within 10 days.
newsitem.headline: SAI to name two new heads within 10 days.

text.p: Italian insurance group Societa' Assicuratrice Industriale (SAI ) will announce a new chairman and also a new managing director within the next 10 days, said the company's director general Luciano Roasio.

He was speaking after it was confirmed that chairman Salvatore Ligresti and managing director Fausto Rapisarda had resigned from the group, but Roasio added that the time of a board meeting to name the replacements had not been fixed.
"I am convinced that the name of the new chairman and managing director will be decided on within a week, with a maximum of ten days," Roasio said.
The Turin-based group which is Italy's largest motor insurer is controlled by Premafin, the holding group of Ligresti, and French group GAN.

The resignations were demanded by Italian insurance watchdog Isvap after Ligresti and Rapisardo were found guilty of corruption charges relating to bribes paid by SAI to win an insurance contract from the state energy group ENI.
Roasio said that the independence of the company over the past years with Ligresti as chairman is likely to continue with Ligresti in the capacity of a shareholder.

SAI has been put in the spotlight as a takeover candidate due the uncertainty regarding the group and by 1450 GMT, SAI shares were up 0.67 percent at 13,810 lire in a slightly firmer Milan stock market.
